about.h:
( Company )
We build agents that run operations.
People stay in control.

Trios Technologies Private Limited is the company behind TWWIOS — an AI agent platform for business operations.

( 01 ) Who we are
Trios
Technologies

Trios Technologies Private Limited builds TWWIOS: autonomous AI agents that take on repetitive operational work — invoices, collections, support, inventory, reporting — inside the systems teams already use.

We believe operations teams should supervise work, not drown in it. So every agent we ship asks for approval before it acts, and leaves a record of what it did.

research.d: How Trios Technologies tests agent reliability: methods first, results when they are real.
research.h:
( Research )
We test in the open.
Methods first.

Our research agenda, the experiments we are designing, and how we will publish what we learn.

( 01 ) Method
How we
run research

Every experiment starts as a written hypothesis. We define the method and the measures before we run anything, test beside real teams in shadow mode, and have people review the outcome.

( 02 ) Agenda
What we
are studying

Reliable execution

How often is an agent’s draft accepted by a person without edits? We build evaluation sets from the documents teams really handle: invoices, vouchers, purchase orders, tickets.

Approval design

When should an agent ask? Too many prompts cause approval fatigue; too few add risk. We study confidence thresholds and which actions always need a human.

Language and voice

Hindi, English and code-mixed conversations across WhatsApp and voice: accuracy, tone and when to hand over to a person.

Cost and latency

Routing each task to the smallest model that does the job well, and measuring the real cost per completed task.

( 04 ) Ground rules
Research
ethics

Consent first

We use customer data only with permission, and never publish it.

Method before result

Hypotheses are written down before the first run.

Negative results count

What did not work is as useful as what did.

then run

protection

Human approval

An agent prepares the action. A person approves or rejects it before anything runs.

Each run gets an audit ID and a recorded decision, approved or rejected.

privacy.d: How Trios Technologies handles personal information in TWWIOS.
privacy.h:
( Privacy )
Privacy
Policy

What we collect, why, who sees it, and how you delete it.

( 01 )
Who we
are
To be completed by Trios Technologies Private Limited before launch: registered office address, grievance/contact email, data retention period, governing-law city. These are marked [ ] below and must be filled in and reviewed by a lawyer.

Trios Technologies Private Limited ("Trios") operates TWWIOS. For the contact lists our customers upload, the customer decides why and how the data is used and Trios processes it on their behalf.

( 02 )
What we
collect
  • Account: name, work email, company name, a hashed password.
  • WhatsApp connection: your WhatsApp Business Account ID, phone number ID and access token. The token is encrypted at rest.
  • Contacts you upload: phone numbers, names, any extra columns you add, and the record of where and when each person opted in.
  • Messages: the templates you send, delivery status (sent, delivered, read, failed), customers' replies and our automatic responses.
  • Usage logs: actions such as starting a campaign, for security and audit.
( 03 )
How we
use it
  • To send the messages you ask us to send and to show delivery results and replies.
  • To enforce safety rules: consent checks, opt-outs, frequency limits and quality protection.
  • To secure the service and prevent abuse.
  • We do not sell personal information and do not use contact lists for advertising.
( 04 )
Who it is
shared with
  • Meta Platforms (WhatsApp Business Platform): to deliver messages and receive delivery and reply events.
  • Hosting and database providers that run TWWIOS for us, under contract.
  • Authorities when the law requires it.
( 05 )
Your
choices
  • Delete any contact, or your entire account and data, from the product: Settings, Delete account.
  • People who message our customers can reply STOP at any time to stop messages.
  • To access or correct information, contact us at [email].
  • Retention: contacts and messages are kept until you delete them or close your account. Logs are kept for [ ] days.
( 06 )
Security

Access tokens are encrypted, passwords are hashed, each customer can see only their own data, and webhook calls from Meta are signature-checked. No system is perfectly secure; tell us at once if you suspect a problem.

Last updated: 6 November 2026.

Privacy questions?

Contact us and we will respond.

TWWIOS is provided by Trios Technologies Private Limited ("Trios", "we"). By creating an account you agree to these terms on behalf of your business.

responsibilities
  • You may message only people who have agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from you, and you must keep proof of that consent.

  • You must follow the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service, the WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy and Meta's Commerce Policy.
  • No spam, deceptive, unlawful, or prohibited content, and no messages to purchased or scraped lists.
  • Keep your login and API key secret. You are responsible for activity under your account.

WhatsApp
and Meta

Messages are sent through the official WhatsApp Business Platform. Meta sets message prices, approves templates, and controls messaging limits and quality ratings. Meta may restrict or suspend a number. Trios cannot control those decisions and does not guarantee approval, delivery or any messaging limit. Meta charges for messages are separate from your TWWIOS plan unless your plan says otherwise.
